name: llm_profile_storage_resolution_defaults
description: Managed guidance for resolving a user-confirmed job requirement into the candidate profile without creating duplicate top-level facts.
lines: The user has explicitly confirmed the one atomic candidate fact represented by canonical_hint. Do not reassess job fit and do not infer, rename, expand, or add any other candidate fact. Your only semantic decision is where that exact confirmed fact belongs: existing, new, or unresolved.

canonical_hint is the only fact that may be persisted. requirement and matched_job_text are semantic context for choosing a destination only; they are never a source of additional user confirmations. Never promote examples, alternatives, qualifiers, or neighbouring phrases from those fields into profile data.
Decide only where this confirmed fact belongs in the existing candidate profile: existing, new, or unresolved.

Use existing when the confirmed canonical fact genuinely belongs as an alternate or narrower Related Skill under one existing canonical profile item without changing that item's semantic claim. A professional association is not enough: do not attach a domain or industry experience fact beneath an unrelated functional or professional capability. Set existing_name to that exact canonical name from the supplied profile items. Do not create another top-level item just because the job uses different wording.

existing means an item that is literally present in existing_profile_items. Never echo canonical_hint or the job requirement into existing_name unless that exact item is present in existing_profile_items. If no supplied profile item fits, choose new or unresolved.

canonical_hint is a label from an earlier step, not a member of existing_profile_items, and matching-sounding text is not evidence of a match. For example, if canonical_hint is "Java" but no item in existing_profile_items is named or aliased "Java", the correct resolution is new — never resolve to a same-named or lookalike existing_name that is not actually listed.

For existing capability resolution, choose only the exact existing canonical capability that genuinely owns canonical_hint as a Related Skill. The application will persist canonical_hint itself; you do not propose or generate any additional Related Skills. A professional association is not enough: Financial Services Experience must not be placed under Governance and Compliance Management merely because financial services is regulated.
Use new only when the confirmed fact is one distinct reusable top-level profile concept that does not belong under any supplied existing item. Set new_name to one concise canonical concept.
Do not merge distinct concepts merely to avoid creating a new item. If putting the fact under an existing item would materially broaden what that item claims, use new instead.
Use unresolved for compound requirements, alternatives, vague groups, or any case where one safe storage destination cannot be chosen. Leave existing_name and new_name empty for unresolved.

For existing, set existing_name to the exact supplied profile item and leave new_name empty. For new, set new_name to a concise canonical form of canonical_hint and leave existing_name empty. For unresolved, leave both empty.
Return the minimum profile change needed to represent the user-confirmed fact.
